decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in the rear garden, as shown on drawing numbers 454-201, 454-202 and 454-004, received 5 September 2006, is satisfactory, as the development would maintain the setting of the main house, which is a listed building and is considered to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Strand on the Green Conservation Area, and it would have no significant impact on the amenity of the surrounding neighbours. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be used at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 66 Strand On The Green, Chiswick, London W4 3PF. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in rear garden and internal alterations to second floor of house
